start_year.description: Lower publication calendar year, for example 2020; null means no lower year bound.

end_year.description: Upper publication calendar year, for example 2026; null means no upper year bound.

min_similarity.description: Dimensionless similarity threshold from 0 to 1, not percent; defaults to 0.5.

top_k.description: Maximum papers to return (count), 1–200; defaults to 50.

auto_ingest.description: Whether AutoPaper may fetch and ingest online papers when local results are insufficient. Omission preserves the upstream default, currently true.
